title: Nithin M
text:
I am an economist working at the intersection of macroeconomics, applied econometrics, and development.
I currently serve as Assistant Professor and Head, Department of Development Economics at Kerala Agricultural University. My work combines economic reasoning with empirical analysis, with particular interests in consumption dynamics, policy, and data-driven research.
This website brings together my research, teaching, academic presentations, and contact information.



Research
My current work focuses on macroeconomic behaviour, household consumption, and empirical methods for understanding economic change.


Teaching
I teach undergraduate and postgraduate courses in economics and applied policy. Current course materials are listed on the new teaching page.


Academic Profile
You can access my CV, research papers, talks, and academic profiles through the links above and on this page.

title: Research
text:
Work in Progress
Does Sentiment Predict Consumption Growth of Indian Households? [Slides] [Latest Version]
This is a joint work with Dr. Siddhartha Chattopadhyay of IIT Kharagpur and Dr. Sohini Sahu of IIT Kanpur.
